16. Secure Cookie Flags

SIMPLE ENGLISH
HttpOnly restricts script access, Secure limits transmission to secure connections, and SameSite
controls cross-site sending.
සිංහJලෙන් HttpOnly නිසා JavaScript එකට cookie කියවන්න බැහැ. Secure HTTPS සඳහායි. SameSite cross-
site requests සඳහා cookie යැවීම පාලනය කරනවා.
A same-site web app stores an opaque session ID in a protected cookie.
